name: Swarm documentation
summary: The Swarm documentation site, built with Docusaurus. It stays at Level 2 whatever its source: when it opens it loads Matomo's analytics script from mtm.swarm.foundation without an integrity hash and reports the visit. The KaTeX stylesheet from jsDelivr is pinned by an integrity hash.
